text.description_html:
Weslock Single Cylinder Handleset Impresa Knob Interior Trim

This is a single cylinder interior time set to be used with the Weslock Lexington Interconnected Handleset. It comes packaged as the interior trim only with the Impresa Knob.

Features and Specifications of the Interior Impresa Knob for the Lexington Interconnected Handleset:

  • Length: 6"
  • Width: 3-1/8""
  • Knob Diameter: 2-3/16"
  • Knob Projection: 2-1/8""

Special Ordered Item. NO RETURNS.
